morph_evaluation: Uses actual mesh shape-key delta arrays after topology replacement. Runtime death morph_weights interpolated between compressed samples. Legacy EnemyGrip_R=1 ignored for graft because fixed grip Basis has no such shape key.
limits: Triangle surface intersection sampled at keys and midpoints, not continuous collision or volume containment. Own-cuff overlap inside first 2 cm of wrist is counted separately as intentional graft join; distal palm overlap is not excluded.
